products.title: Rainbow Sapphire Bezel Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Bold color meets clean modern design in the Rainbow Bezel Tennis Bracelet. A continuous row of vibrant natural sapphires is individually framed in sleek polished bezels, allowing every gemstone to shine with crisp definition while creating a smooth, contemporary profile.

Crafted in sthrdy 14K gold, the bezel setting emphasizes each sapphire’s unique color while offering exceptional durability for everyday wear. The result is a refined take on rainbow jewelry—vibrant yet sophisticated, playful yet unmistakably luxurious.

products.title: Honeycomb Diamond Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Modern geometry meets timeless brilliance in the Hexagon Diamond Tennis Bracelet. Inspired by the elegant symmetry of a honeycomb, each hexagonal link frames a brilliant natural diamond, creating an architectural silhouette that feels simultaneously organic and contemporary.

Crafted in solid 14K white gold, the repeating hexagonal pattern gives the bracelet striking texture while maintaining the fluid comfort of a traditional tennis bracelet. Available in multiple carat weights, this distinctive design offers a bold yet refined alternative to the classic round-link tennis bracelet.

products.title: Diamond Puzzle Dice Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Fine jewelry with a clever point of view, the Diamond Puzzle Dice Tennis Bracelet replaces the traditional line of matching settings with a sequence of polished gold tiles, each arranged with its own distinctive diamond pattern. Round diamonds are individually bezel set across articulated square links, appearing in varied one- and two-stone placements. The changing arrangement recalls both puzzle pieces fitting together and the playful pips of dice, giving the bracelet an unexpected visual rhythm from link to link.

Crafted in rich 14K yellow gold, the smooth geometric tiles create a substantial, almost watch-bracelet-inspired silhouette. The diamonds appear embedded within the polished surface rather than sitting above it, producing a sleek contrast between crisp gold planes and bright points of light. Structured yet flexible, graphic yet wearable, this bracelet offers a completely different interpretation of tennis jewelry. It is designed for the collector who appreciates classic materials but prefers her diamonds with a little wit.

products.title: Diamond Graduating Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A subtle shift in scale gives the Graduated Diamond Tennis Bracelet its beautifully balanced presence. Round diamonds vary in width gradually toward the center of the wrist; the progression from smaller stones to more prominent center diamonds adds dimension without interrupting the bracelet’s fluid line. Light builds gently across the design, culminating at the center in a brighter, more pronounced moment of brilliance.

Crafted in polished 14K white gold, each diamond is carefully arranged to create a seamless transition in size and sparkle. The flexible articulated construction allows the bracelet to curve comfortably around the wrist, while the graduated contour gives it a refined distinction from a uniform tennis style. Timeless at first glance and thoughtfully different upon closer inspection, it is a graceful interpretation of an essential diamond bracelet.

products.title: Double Diamond Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Twice the diamonds, beautifully balanced. The Two-Row Diamond Tennis Bracelet brings added dimension to an enduring fine-jewelry icon, arranging two parallel lines of brilliant round diamonds in a fluid ribbon of light. The closely set rows create a broader, more substantial presence on the wrist while preserving the graceful movement and refinement of a traditional tennis bracelet.

Crafted in polished 14K white gold, the articulated links help the bracelet follow the wrist comfortably, balancing statement-level impact with the flexibility needed for effortless wear. Bold enough to stand alone yet streamlined enough to join a larger stack, this design turns a timeless staple into something richer, brighter, and unmistakably elevated.

products.title: Ruby Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
The Ruby Tennis Bracelet reimagines an enduring silhouette through the lens of one of the world’s most storied gemstones. Set in a continuous line, richly saturated rubies encircle the wrist with warmth and intensity. Finished in luminous 14K gold, this piece is designed to be worn instinctively—stacked with meaning or worn alone as a signature. A classic not because it follows tradition, but because it endures.

Rubies have long symbolized love, vitality, and protection. In this design, that symbolism is distilled into something wearable every day: refined yet expressive, bold yet effortlessly elegant. The bracelet moves fluidly with the wrist, catching light with each gesture, never overstated, always present.

products.title: Alternating Diamond Pears Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Graceful curves and brilliant sparkle come together in the Alternating Pear Diamond Flexible Tennis Bracelet. Featuring pear-shaped natural diamonds arranged in alternating directions sprinkled around the wrist, each diamond is separated by delicate round diamonds and links that create beautiful rhythm and movement around the wrist.

Crafted in solid 14K gold, the flexible construction offers exceptional comfort while allowing the distinctive pear silhouettes to catch the light from every angle. Elegant enough for formal occasions yet refined for everyday luxury, this bracelet offers a fresh interpretation of the classic tennis bracelet through one of diamond’s most romantic shapes.

products.title: Skinny Baguette Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Clean, graphic, and endlessly wearable, this cultivated diamond tennis bracelet brings a sharp, modern edge to a classic silhouette. The linear shape of each east-west set baguette reflects light in a smooth, mirror-like way, creating a look that feels polished rather than flashy. Set in 14k gold, the bracelet sits comfortably along the wrist with a refined, streamlined presence. 

The uninterrupted row of baguette diamonds gives it a sense of intention and clarity — equally striking worn on its own or layered with softer, round-cut styles. This is the kind of piece that becomes a staple quickly. Easy to wear, easy to style, and designed to feel relevant year after year — not because it follows trends, but because it doesn’t need to.

products.title: Diamond Pave Loop Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Clean architectural lines meet brilliant sparkle in the Diamond Pavé Loop Tennis Bracelet. Alternating polished open links and pavé diamond-set loops create rhythm, texture, and dimension while maintaining the sleek profile of a modern tennis bracelet.

Each sculptural link adds subtle movement and visual interest, making this bracelet feel contemporary yet timeless. Whether worn alone or layered with classic diamond tennis styles, its distinctive silhouette offers a fresh interpretation of an enduring icon.

products.title: Rainbow Sapphire and Diamond Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A celebration of color and sparkle, the Confetti Diamond Tennis Bracelet reimagines the classic tennis bracelet with vibrant natural sapphires scattered between brilliant white diamonds. Rather than following a repeating rainbow sequence, each colorful sapphire appears organically throughout the bracelet, creating a joyful composition that feels effortless, modern, and completely unique.

Crafted in 14K gold, the alternating diamonds provide brilliant contrast while vivid sapphires in shades of pink, blue, green, yellow, orange, and purple create unexpected moments of color. Elegant enough for everyday wear yet playful enough to stand apart, this design captures the spirit of celebration in an endlessly wearable silhouette.

products.title: Diamond Tennis Choker
products.bodyHtml:
Modern, refined, and endlessly versatile, the Diamond Tennis Choker brings the unmistakable brilliance of a classic tennis necklace into a shorter, fashion-forward silhouette. A continuous line of brilliant round diamonds rests gracefully along the collarbone, creating a luminous frame that feels both understated and impactful. The choker offers a contemporary profile that layers beautifully while making a striking statement on its own.

Crafted in polished 14K gold, its clean silhouette pairs effortlessly with everything from crisp tailoring to eveningwear, making it one of the most versatile diamond pieces in any collection. The shorter length naturally draws attention to the face while delivering the timeless sparkle that has made tennis jewelry an enduring icon. Whether worn as your everyday signature or reserved for special occasions, this is a piece that feels equally classic and current.

products.title: Rainbow Sapphire Tennis Choker
products.bodyHtml:
Vibrant, expressive, and effortlessly elegant, the Sapphire Tennis Choker celebrates color in its most refined form. A continuous line of brilliantly cut sapphires wraps gracefully around the neckline, creating a luminous spectrum that feels joyful without overwhelming. Set in warm 14K yellow or rose gold, each gemstone contributes its own character to the composition, resulting in a colorful yet sophisticated piece that instantly brightens any jewelry collection.

Its shorter, 14 inch choker length allows the sapphires to frame the face beautifully, while the uninterrupted line of color creates an eye-catching yet refined look. Wear it as a statement on its own or layer it with longer diamond necklaces for an effortlessly collected look. Rich in color and timeless in craftsmanship, it’s a celebration of individuality through fine jewelry.

products.title: Diamond Graduating Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
Graceful from every angle, the Graduated Diamond Tennis Necklace offers a refined interpretation of one of fine jewelry’s most enduring silhouettes. Rather than maintaining a uniform profile throughout, brilliant round diamonds gradually fluctuate in size like a wave, creating a beautifully balanced composition that naturally draws the eye. The result is a tennis necklace that feels both timeless and thoughtfully modern—subtle in its distinction yet unmistakably luxurious.

Beautiful on its own and equally striking layered with shorter station necklaces or delicate chains, this is the kind of piece that becomes a cornerstone of a well-loved jewelry collection. A timeless classic, elevated through thoughtful design.

products.title: Mosaic Dangle Diamond Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
A refined line of round brilliant diamonds forms the foundation of the necklace, while individually suspended fancy-shape diamonds create a delicate fringe along its length. Pear, emerald, cushion, round, and other distinctive cuts appear at thoughtful intervals, giving each stone space to move and catch the light from a different angle. The contrast between the structured tennis line and the airy diamond drops gives the necklace a couture-inspired quality without making it feel overly ornate.

Crafted in polished 14K white gold, it brings together crisp diamond geometry and graceful movement in a piece that feels glamorous, expressive, and unexpectedly versatile. Wear it as the focal point of an evening look, or pair it with a clean neckline and tailored separates for a more modern interpretation.

products.title: Full Bezel Diamond Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
Effortless, refined, and endlessly wearable, the Bezel Diamond Station Necklace brings together floating brilliance and timeless simplicity. Individually framed diamonds create a delicate rhythm of sparkle that feels both understated and unforgettable.

 

 

The Bezel Diamond Station Necklace features a series of brilliant diamonds, each individually bezel set to create a clean, contemporary silhouette. The minimal 14K gold surrounds every stone with a smooth polished frame, allowing each diamond to catch the light while adding a subtle architectural element to the design.

Elegant enough to wear alone and delicate enough to layer effortlessly, this necklace transitions seamlessly from casual mornings to evening occasions. Its refined proportions make it an essential foundation piece—beautiful beneath an open collar, layered with tennis necklaces, or paired with meaningful pendants.

products.title: Rainbow Sapphire and Diamond Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
The Confetti Tennis Necklace celebrates one of fine jewelry’s most iconic silhouettes with vibrant sapphires artfully dispersed among brilliant diamonds. Each colorful accent creates an unexpected moment of brilliance, giving the necklace its signature “confetti” effect—refined enough for everyday luxury, yet distinctive enough to turn heads.

Crafted in rich 14K gold, the warm glow of beautifully complements the lively spectrum of sapphires while enhancing the brilliance of each diamond. The colorful gemstones appear almost like tiny celebrations woven throughout an otherwise timeless design, creating movement, personality, and effortless charm.

products.title: Pear EW Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A line of pear-cut diamonds, arranged in a fluid, elongated silhouette — a refined update to the classic tennis bracelet, set in versatile 14k gold. Each stone is positioned to enhance both brilliance and shape, creating a continuous flow of light across the wrist.

The tapered form of the pear cut introduces subtle movement and direction, giving the bracelet a more sculpted, modern feel while maintaining timeless appeal. Elegant yet easy, this piece brings a softer structure to everyday styling — perfect worn alone or layered for added dimension.

products.title: Bezel Hearts Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Heart-shaped diamonds, framed in sleek 14k gold bezel settings — a modern romantic bracelet with a clean, polished edge. This cultivated diamond bracelet brings softness and structure together, with each heart-cut stone set in a smooth white gold frame that emphasizes its shape while creating a seamless line of sparkle.

The bezel setting gives the bracelet a more sculptural, contemporary feel, adding definition around each diamond while keeping the silhouette refined and wearable. Romantic yet modern, this piece feels sweet without being overly delicate — a playful fine jewelry staple that stands beautifully alone or layers effortlessly with classic tennis styles.

products.title: Horizontal Hearts Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A continuous line of heart-shaped diamonds, linked in soft symmetry — a romantic yet modern take on the tennis bracelet, set in polished 14K gold. Each stone is precisely set to create a seamless flow of light, forming a silhouette that feels both delicate and intentional.

 

The repetition of heart cuts creates a uniform sparkle with a softer edge, while the open setting allows each diamond to catch and reflect light with every movement. Sweet yet elevated, this bracelet balances playfulness with polish — a statement piece that wears just as effortlessly alone as it does layered.

products.title: Alternating Fancy Shape Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Diamonds in every shape, linked in modern geometry — a playful yet sophisticated bracelet set in sleek 14K white gold. This mixed cut diamond bracelet brings variety and rhythm to the wrist. Each link showcases a different diamond shape — round, cushion, pear and marquis — set  seamlessly in a line of sparkle. The alternating cuts create a dynamic sparkle that shifts with every movement.

    Playful yet refined, this bracelet feels art deco meets modern minimalism — a versatile piece that stands beautifully alone or layers effortlessly with classic tennis styles.

products.title: Alternating Emerald & Round Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet is defined by contrast that feels natural rather than deliberate. Round cultivated diamonds catch the light with softness and movement, while baguette cuts introduce calm structure — together forming approximately 10 TCW of quiet rhythm that unfolds along the wrist. The result is balanced, luminous, and composed, never overstated.

Crafted in 14K white gold, the alternating stones create subtle variation without interrupting the classic tennis silhouette. The bracelet feels thoughtful and architectural, yet effortless — designed to be lived in rather than reserved. This piece resists trend in favor of proportion and permanence.

products.title: East West Emerald Mixed Bezel Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This isn’t your standard emerald-cut tennis bracelet — it plays with proportion and direction. Set east-west and framed in smooth bezels, each emerald-cut lab diamond sits horizontally across the wrist, creating a crisp, modern line that feels more architectural than traditional.

 

The alternating stone sizes add a subtle rhythm as you move, like a quiet pattern you notice more the longer you wear it. Clean, graphic, and unexpectedly flattering, it reads minimal from afar and quietly design-forward up close — the kind of piece that gets compliments from people who “don’t even notice jewelry.”

 

A classic silhouette with a clever point of view.

 

 

 

 

Key Details

 

 

  • 14K white gold
  • Lab-grown emerald-cut diamonds
  • East-west orientation (horizontal setting)
  • Bezel-set for a smooth, modern profile
  • Alternating diamond sizes for dimension and rhythm
  • Secure clasp closure

products.bodyHtml:
A modern classic with intention. This bezel-set mixed-shape lab diamond tennis bracelet pairs sculptural stone silhouettes with a smooth, polished frame—creating a look that’s refined, contemporary, and quietly bold. Each diamond is individually bezel set, giving the bracelet its fluid feel and elevated, design-forward edge.

Designed to feel substantial yet effortless, this is a tennis bracelet for those who appreciate detail over tradition.

products.title: Large Baguette Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:

The linear shape of each east-west set baguette reflects light in a smooth, mirror-like way, creating a look that feels polished rather than flashy. Set in 14k gold, the bracelet sits along the wrist with a refined, streamlined presence. 

The uninterrupted row of baguette diamonds gives it a sense of intention and clarity — equally striking worn on its own or layered with softer, round-cut styles. This is the kind of piece that becomes a staple quickly. Easy to wear, easy to style, and designed to feel relevant year after year — not because it follows trends, but because it doesn’t need to.

products.title: Fancy Shape Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Facets in every shape, linked in modern geometry — a playful yet sophisticated bracelet set in sleek 14K white gold. This mixed cut diamond bracelet brings variety and rhythm to the wrist. Each link showcases a different diamond shape — round, emerald, pear, marquis and oval — set within bold geometry that connect seamlessly. The alternating cuts create a dynamic sparkle that shifts with every movement.

    Playful yet refined, this bracelet feels art deco meets modern minimalism — a versatile piece that stands beautifully alone or layers effortlessly with any wrist stack.

products.title: Alternating Buttercup Diamond Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
This necklace plays with contrast in the most refined way — light and dark, rhythm and pause, precision softened by movement. Alternating white and black diamonds are set along the collar in graduating buttercup mounts, creating a subtle pattern that feels intentional rather than uniform.

 

The crown-style 18K gold settings give each stone its own presence, allowing light to move freely while maintaining a fluid, wearable silhouette. Varying mount sizes add depth and dimension, keeping the necklace visually dynamic without ever feeling busy. Striking on its own and effortless when layered, this is a piece that balances edge with elegance — collected, confident, and meant to be worn often.

products.title: Diamond & Ruby Geometric Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet introduces geometry into the tennis silhouette in a way that feels fresh and intentional. Hexagon-set diamonds and rubies alternate along the wrist, bringing structure, color, and contrast into a clean, modern rhythm.

 

Crafted in 14K gold with a flexible construction, the bracelet moves easily with the wrist while maintaining a graphic, architectural look. The mix of crisp white diamonds and rich red ruby keeps the design lively without feeling busy. It’s a confident piece — playful, polished, and designed for someone who appreciates classic jewelry with a point of view.

products.title: Diamond & Emerald Geometric Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet pairs vibrant green emerald with crisp diamond sparkle in a geometric design that feels both fresh and timeless. The hexagon settings bring structure, while the flexible form keeps the look relaxed and easy.

 

Crafted in 14K gold, the emerald adds a pop of color that feels confident and intentional rather than ornate. It’s a piece that stands out quietly — graphic, elegant, and endlessly wearable.

products.title: Diamond & Sapphire Geometric Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet brings a graphic edge to the classic tennis silhouette through clean geometry and carefully chosen color. Hexagon-set diamonds alternate with sapphires, creating a structured rhythm that feels modern, playful, and thoughtfully balanced. Crafted in 14K gold with a flexible tennis construction, the bracelet moves easily with the wrist, keeping the look relaxed and wearable.

Offered in either blue or pink sapphire, each variation brings its own personality — blue feels calm and composed, while pink adds a softer, more expressive note — without changing the refined foundation of the design. It’s a piece that feels confident and current without chasing trends. Distinctive, easy to wear, and designed to stand out quietly over time.

products.title: Diamond Round Station Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet is all about restraint — natural diamonds placed with intention rather than excess. Spaced along a flexible line of 14K gold, each stone catches the light on its own, creating a look that feels light, modern, and quietly luxurious.

The flexible tennis construction gives it an easy, natural drape, making it one of those pieces you forget you’re wearing — until it catches the light. It’s subtle, refined, and endlessly wearable. Perfect for stacking or wearing solo, this is a bracelet that fits seamlessly into everyday life while still feeling considered.

products.title: Tsavorite & Diamond Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A fresh take on the tennis bracelet, this design alternates crisp white natural diamonds with vibrant green tsavorite. The color contrast feels lively yet refined, adding personality without overpowering the silhouette. Set in 14K white gold with flexible construction, the bracelet moves naturally and wears comfortably throughout the day.

It’s an easy way to introduce color into a classic look — subtle enough for daily wear, distinctive enough to stand out. A perfect choice for those who love diamonds but want something a little more expressive.

products.title: Blue Sapphire Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This flexible tennis bracelet brings a fresh perspective to a classic silhouette through the rich, saturated blue of natural sapphires. Set in 14k white gold, the stones create a continuous line of color that feels both polished and playful—elevated, but never overly formal.

 

The flexible construction allows the bracelet to drape comfortably while maintaining a refined, tailored look. The sapphires catch the light with depth rather than flash, offering a more understated kind of brilliance that works just as easily day-to-day as it does layered for evening. This is a piece that adds personality without sacrificing longevity—a modern essential meant to be worn often, and without hesitation.

products.title: Emerald Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Crafted in 14K gold with a flexible tennis construction, the bracelet drapes naturally along the wrist. The prong setting grounds the color while the flexibility keeps the look relaxed — refined without feeling formal.

 

This bracelet brings emerald into a softer, more wearable form. Each stone creates a smooth rhythm of green that feels calm, modern, and intentional. It’s a piece that works effortlessly into daily wear, offering color that feels considered rather than precious.

products.title: Diamond Chevron Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
This necklace introduces direction and movement through a repeating chevron motif, set with elongated baguette diamonds that catch the light in a sharp, graphic rhythm. The silhouette feels architectural yet wearable—clean lines, softened by fluid drape.

 

Designed with intention, the necklace features diamonds along the front half, transitioning into polished  14k gold along the back. This half-diamond construction keeps the piece light, balanced, and effortless, while allowing the chevron pattern to remain the focus where it matters most. Subtle in sparkle, strong in design, and endlessly versatile—this is a piece that elevates without overpowering.

products.title: Bezel Set Diamond Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Smooth, refined, and quietly confident, this bracelet frames each diamond in a polished bezel, creating a continuous line of light with a modern sensibility. The setting softens the sparkle just enough, offering glow rather than flash. Crafted in 14K gold, the bezel design brings a sense of structure and intention to the classic tennis silhouette.

Whether finished in a traditional tennis construction or a more fluid flexible style, it wears comfortably along the wrist with a clean, contemporary feel. This is a piece chosen for longevity — understated, versatile, and designed to feel just as relevant years from now as it does today.

products.title: Black Diamond Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
This tennis necklace offers a darker, more understated expression of a classic silhouette. Set with natural black diamonds, it delivers a subtle sheen rather than traditional sparkle—quiet, confident, and unmistakably modern. A modern staple designed to anchor a look, day or night.

 

Crafted in 14k white gold, the continuous line of black diamonds sits cleanly along the neckline, creating contrast through tone rather than brilliance. The effect is refined and minimal, with just enough edge to feel distinctive. It’s the kind of piece that doesn’t announce itself, but never goes unnoticed.

products.title: Box Set Diamond Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This flexible tennis bracelet is defined by its clean geometry. Each natural diamond is set within a softly squared, box-like frame, creating a continuous line that feels architectural yet effortless on the wrist. Offered in white or yellow gold, this style feels quietly confident. 

 

The box-set design offers a slightly more structured look than a traditional prong or bezel setting, while the flexible construction keeps the bracelet fluid and comfortable. The result is crisp without being rigid — a modern silhouette that still wears like a classic. It’s the kind of bracelet that reads polished up close, but never tries too hard from across the room.

products.title: Diamond Double Flexible Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet plays with proportion in the most effortless way. Designed to wrap the wrist twice, it gives the look of layered diamonds with the ease of a single, fluid piece—polished, intentional, and quietly confident. It’s the kind of piece that looks styled without trying—substantial enough to stand on its own, subtle enough to become an everyday signature.

 

Crafted in 14K gold and set with natural diamonds, the flexible construction moves naturally with the wrist, creating a soft drape rather than a rigid line. Whether worn in white gold for a clean, luminous finish or yellow gold for warmth and contrast, the effect is refined but never fussy.

products.title: Diamond Zig Zag Buttercup Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet takes the traditional buttercup setting and gives it movement. Set in a subtle zig-zag pattern, each diamond is lifted in a crown-style frame that enhances brilliance while creating a lively, rhythmic flow along the wrist.

 

With natural diamonds set in 14K gold, the alternating placement adds texture and visual energy without straying from a classic tennis silhouette. The buttercup setting allows light to enter from all sides, giving the bracelet depth and sparkle that feels dimensional rather than flat.

 

Offered in two carat weights, this piece lets you choose your presence — the 2 carat version feels refined and easy for everyday wear, while the 4 carat option brings a fuller, more expressive statement. Both are timeless, confident, and designed to be worn instinctively.

products.title: Diamond Buttercup Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
This bracelet takes its name from the setting itself — a classic buttercup design that gently lifts each diamond, allowing light to enter from every angle. The result is a tennis bracelet that feels bright, dimensional, and unmistakably timeless.

In 14K yellow gold and set with natural diamonds, each stone is framed by softly scalloped metal that adds texture and character without overpowering the silhouette. The crown-like profile creates subtle depth along the wrist, giving the bracelet a presence that’s elegant rather than showy.

products.title: Bezel Set Ruby Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Rich color meets clean design in this bezel set ruby tennis bracelet. Each ruby is framed in polished 14K gold, allowing the color to take center stage while maintaining a smooth, uninterrupted silhouette.

The bezel setting gives the bracelet a modern, composed feel, while the tennis form keeps it timeless. Offered in both classic and flexible constructions, it wears beautifully — structured enough to feel intentional, comfortable enough for everyday. It’s a confident way to wear color: bold, but refined; expressive, but enduring.

products.title: Tilted Emerald Cut Lab Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Diamonds in every shape, linked in modern geometry — a playful yet sophisticated bracelet set in sleek 14K white gold. This mixed cut diamond bracelet brings variety and rhythm to the wrist. Each link showcases a different diamond shape — round, emerald, cushion, oval — set within bold geometric bezels that connect seamlessly in a chain. The alternating cuts create a dynamic sparkle that shifts with every movement.

    Playful yet refined, this bracelet feels art deco meets modern minimalism — a versatile piece that stands beautifully alone or layers effortlessly with classic tennis styles.

products.title: Tanzanite Tennis Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A bracelet for someone who loves gemstones that stand apart from the ordinary, and appreciates pieces with a story as captivating as their sparkle. This style is set with violet hued tanzanite gemstones, each one chosen for its hypnotic depth of color — the kind of luminous hue that shifts and shimmers in changing light. Set in 14k white gold, the bracelet glows with a soft but unmistakable radiance.

A rare treasure from a single place on Earth, Tanzania. Because tanzanite is found only in a tiny region near Mount Kilimanjaro, every stone carries a sense of rarity and origin. The tennis bracelet design highlights the natural beauty of each gem, creating a seamless flow of color across the wrist — elegant, alluring, and truly unique.

products.title: Green Emerald Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Emeralds are known as the “stone of spring” — alive with color, vitality, and timeless mystique. Their lush green glow has captivated royalty, romantics and collectors for centuries, from Cleopatra’s treasures to modern icons. Known as the stone of eternal spring, they carry a lush vitality that symbolizes renewal, wisdom, and everlasting love.

In this bracelet, their magic shines uninterrupted: a fluid line of pure emeralds, luminous and bold. Worn alone, it’s an emblem of strength and beauty; stacked, it adds depth and richness to any collection. This is jewelry not just to wear, but to live in — a forever piece that grows with you, season after season.

products.title: Diamond Baguette Chevron Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:

Each link is accented with sleek baguette-cut diamonds, capturing light with clean, geometric brilliance - a modern twist on timeless elegance. 

A versatile piece, this bracelet balances bold geometry and delicate sparkle, making it the perfect style statement for both day-to-night.

Available in White, Yellow and Rose Gold

products.title: Oval Sapphire + Diamond Mix Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A celebration of color and light, this bracelet features a radiant sequence of oval-cut rainbow sapphires, seamlessly ombré from hue to hue, accented with sparkling natural diamonds. Set in luminous 14K yellow gold, it’s a modern heirloom that balances playful vibrancy with timeless sophistication.

Our Rainbow Ombré Sapphire & Diamond Bracelet captures the joy of color and the elegance of diamonds — all in one unforgettable piece. Like a painted sky after a summer storm, each sapphire shifts gently into the next, creating a fluid ombré of color. Diamonds dance between the sapphires, making this bracelet shimmer with both sophistication and joy.

products.title: Bi-Color Fancy Sapphires Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
This isn’t your ordinary tennis necklace. Instead of diamonds, a continuous stream of round bicolor sapphires brings a wash of blue-green brilliance, each stone shifting between seafoam and teal depending on the light. The cool gleam of 14k white gold enhances the watery tones, creating a piece that feels both modern and timeless.

Each sapphire is one-of-a-kind, with subtle variations in the blue-green mix — making the necklace as unique as its wearer. Slim, refined, and versatile, it’s perfect for layering or as a signature everyday treasure. It’s a jewel for wanderers and dreamers, for anyone who feels at home by the sea or inspired by nature’s palette. Luxe enough for evening, subtle enough for everyday, it’s a reminder that beauty often lives in between — where colors blend, and moments meet.

products.title: Cluster Baguette Diamond Tennis Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
An elegant reimagining of the diamond line, this tennis necklace features a continuous strand of clustered baguette-cut natural diamonds. Artfully arranged to create a rhythmic sparkle — sharper, more architectural than round brilliants, yet still soft enough for everyday wear.  This necklace is a celebration of geometry and glamour, for the woman who moves effortlessly between classic elegance and modern edge.

The baguette cut has long symbolized clarity and direction. Set in sleek 14K white gold, the geometric cuts reflect light in crisp flashes, giving this necklace a sophisticated, modern brilliance. Designed to be worn solo or layered, it’s a piece that balances classic allure with contemporary design.

products.title: Emerald & Round Diamond Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
A modern reimagining of the classic diamond line necklace, this piece alternates brilliant round and elegant emerald-cut natural diamonds in a continuous strand of light. The interplay of shapes creates a refined rhythm, offering both timeless sophistication and a fresh, contemporary twist. Set in 14K white gold, the design is perfect for layering or wearing as a standalone statement of understated luxury.

A necklace of harmony and balance. The round diamonds represent eternity and wholeness, while the emerald cut speak of uniqueness and individuality. Together, they create a graceful rhythm — a melody of light that moves effortlessly with you. This piece is more than adornment; it’s a celebration of contrasts coming together in perfect beauty.

products.title: Pink Ombré Sapphires Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
From soft blush to vivid fuchsia, ombre pink sapphires radiate the many shades of love and emotion. Their gradient tells a story of innocence, passion, tenderness, and vibrancy—capturing the full arc of the heart’s language. 

Pink sapphires are often called the “stones of love,” but in ombre form, they tell a richer tale: from the gentle warmth of first affection to the fiery brilliance of devotion. It’s a gradient of feeling, a wearable poem of the heart.

products.title: Turquoise Cabachon Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Classic tennis style with a bold twist — a line of smooth turquoise cabochons, set in warm 14K yellow gold.

A refreshing take on the tennis bracelet, this piece replaces diamonds with vibrant turquoise cabochons, each stone polished to a smooth dome and meticulously set in radiant 14K yellow gold. The result is a seamless line of bright, sky-blue color encircling the wrist.

The bold pop of turquoise paired with the refined gold setting makes this bracelet both playful and timeless — a piece that shines as a solo statement or layered with diamonds and bangles for contrast.

products.title: Turquoise Cabachon + Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Turquoise meets sparkle — a line of smooth turquoise cabochons accented with alternating diamond stations, set in 14K gold.

 This bracelet brings together the best of both worlds: turquoise cabochons for a burst of vivid blue and alternating diamond stations for refined brilliance. The smooth cabochon turquoise gems are perfectly matched and set in polished four prong mountings, with sparkling round diamonds punctuating the design at regular intervals.

 The effect is a sophisticated rhythm of color and sparkle that feels both fresh and timeless. A perfect piece for those who want everyday casual wearability with a touch of luxury.

products.title: Rainbow Emerald Cut Sapphire Diagonal Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A modern rainbow — emerald-cut sapphires in vivid hues, set diagonally in 14K gold for a bold spectrum of color and geometry.

Each gemstone in this bracelet is a precisely cut emerald-cut sapphire, set on a diagonal orientation to create a zig-zag flow of color across the wrist. Arranged in a radiant ombré rainbow sequence — from passionate reds and pinks through golden yellows, lush greens, and brilliant blues to deep violets — the clean lines of the emerald cut give this playful palette a modern, architectural edge.

products.title: Zig-Zag Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
An icon, reimagined. A fresh take on the classic tennis bracelet, this design features natural diamonds in a zig-zag pattern, crafted in 14K white gold. A modern perspective on a classic motif — instead of a straight line of stones this design features alternating diamonds set in a zig-zag orientation that creates movement, texture, and added sparkle from every angle.

The result? A timeless bracelet with a modern twist — perfect for those who love the elegance of a tennis bracelet but want something a little more distinctive.

products.title: Mixed Shape Diamond Bezel Necklace
products.bodyHtml:
This necklace celebrates the beauty of contrast. A refined strand of mixed-cut diamonds — from the sparkle of round brilliants to the sharp elegance of emeralds, princess, hearts and marquise cuts — creates a rhythmic flow of light across the neckline. Each diamond is bezel-set in polished 14K white gold, giving the piece a modern, clean-lined finish.

Designed to stand out, this necklace layers effortlessly with other pieces yet makes a striking statement on its own. Its mix of shapes makes it timeless yet unexpected — the perfect blend of sophistication and artistry.

products.title: Pink Sapphire & Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Designed to stand out, this bracelet alternates rosy pink sapphires with brilliant white diamonds, each meticulously set in 14K gold. The oval cuts highlight the lively hue of the sapphires, while diamonds add sparkle and contrast. With its feminine charm and modern elegance, this bracelet is an invitation to celebrate color in fine jewelry.

Pink sapphires carry a joyful, romantic energy — they’re the gemstones of love, vitality, and creative spirit. When paired with diamonds, the effect is dazzling yet tender, making this bracelet the perfect token of affection or a beautiful statement of individuality.

products.title: Blue Sapphire & Diamond Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
A classic tennis bracelet reimagined with oval-cut blue sapphires alternating with brilliant white diamonds, set in 14K gold for timeless sophistication. This bracelet pairs the deep, velvety blue of sapphires with the sparkle of round brilliant diamonds, each hand-set in 14K gold. The alternating oval and round pattern creates a graceful rhythm of color and light, while the secure clasp ensures elegance that lasts a lifetime.

Blue sapphires, long prized as symbols of wisdom and nobility, add regal depth to this fresh take on a jewelry icon. Paired with luminous diamonds, this bracelet feels like wearing starlight on your wrist — a piece that’s both classic and powerful, perfect for marking milestones or elevating the everyday.

products.title: Rainbow Hearts Sapphire Bracelet
products.bodyHtml:
Celebrate love and color with this enchanting Rainbow Hearts Sapphire Bracelet.  The ombré design creates a fluid rainbow effect that dances around the wrist. Set in luminous 14K gold, this bracelet is equal parts whimsical and elegant — a keepsake that feels joyful, modern, and timeless all at once. Each heart-shaped sapphire is carefully arranged in a sweeping spectrum of hues — from warm reds to golden yellows, lush greens, with brilliant blues and delicate violets.

This playful yet refined bracelet is a celebration of color, individuality, and love — perfect as a statement piece, anniversary gift, or everyday reminder of joy!

products.title: Pastel Ombré Sapphires Bracelet
products.bodyHtml: Dreamy and delicate, pastel sapphires whisper where others shout—inviting serenity, sweetness, and lightness into your day. With shades like baby blue (calm), pale pink (love), mint green (balance), and soft peach (warmth), these stones offer a gentle kind of strength. They speak to the dreamers, the nurturers, and the ones who find beauty in quiet details. Each stone reflects a softer side of the rainbow—evoking calm, creativity, and quiet joy. It's elegance with a playful spirit.
